sources.title: Visa Application Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The current PDF is served over valid HTTPS by the official foreign.gov.tt Ministry domain; its response declares an 11 September 2025 last-modified timestamp.
sources.supportingExcerpt: To find out if you need a visa, consult the list of countries.

sources.title: List of countries that do not need a visa for Trinidad and Tobago
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration Division service links directly to this Ministry of Homeland Security PDF. The named-list wording is positive only and contains no express complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the countries listed below do not require visas for entry.

sources.title: Visa Online Services
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live HTTPS Ministry page identifies the Immigration Division service and links the external eVisa application host. It gives documents and fee information but no nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Possession of an eVisa does not guarantee your entry into Trinidad and Tobago.

sources.title: Visa & Student Permit
sources.officialityEvidence: The live HTTPS government information page describes Immigration Division's eVisa service. Its eligibility wording is conditional and does not identify any passport nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: eligible foreign nationals from visa-required countries can apply for a Multiple Entry eVisa

sources.title: T&T eVisa entitlement application
sources.publisher: T&T eVisa application host linked by Immigration Division
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration page links this host, but independent direct HTTPS replay received Cloudflare HTTP 403. No selector options, API request, nationality input, or terminal result was accessible without bypassing that control.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You have to enable javascript in your browser to use this web site.
